headline: Party Officials: The NT$10,000 Universal Handout Was Not a Sudden Whim; Economic Growth Dividends Shared by All | Politics
summary: President Lai Ching-te announced a universal cash handout of NT$10,000 next year. Party and government figures said it reflects economic growth and higher tax revenue, while the opposition questioned the DPP's consistency.
why: Universal cash handouts are fiscal measures funded by government spending, which affects the budget deficit and domestic consumption.
